reviews.text: As Gold Ship would say, this game is very good at its presentation. The pixel art and the variety of cityscapes and HD graphics are great, the music and the sounds are really lovely callbacks to this era of pixelated 70's-80's gameplay, and the homage to monster movies and the ridiculous cheese is overflowing, you can clearly feel the love that the devs had for the era of mothmen, succubi, and evil zombie nuns. The gameplay is quite competent, as well. Nothing really different from your active attack horde shooters, especially 2D platformers than 8D movement isometric, but there is a nice variety in the boss mechanics, unique enemies per monster you're fighting, and some really entertaining battles and threats when they pull out their extra mechanics. Some issues with the game is that its stats are a little obscured, relying on context clues, and the English translation is a little obfuscated from what I presume is originally an Asian language. "Increase Safety!" might mean plus defense, and the pop culture references do not translate unmangled and intelligible to Anglophone audiences. Still, it's quite fun, it's not that expensive, and it's a great adult game addition if you happen to like horde survival games oozing with charm.

《妖怪净化人》——捕捉远近闻名的怪物，还可以发生点奇妙小事情？ 作为同制作组旗下的游戏《灵魂恶魔猎人》的r18版本。这款游戏在原有的基础上增加了质量非常不错的动态步兵cg，配音和建模十分精致，并且制作组贴心地为我们准备了游玩2小时即可解锁全cg的功能，可以说是诚意满满。 这是一款非常有特点的类吸血鬼幸存者游戏，与以往的同类游戏不同，这款游戏打破了传统的俯视角，改为了2d横版，同时击杀怪物后，经验直接增加，不需要我们再去捡掉落物，我觉得这个设计非常人性化。 游戏目前共有两张地图，分别是北美洲和亚洲，每个地图内有三个不同的首领需要我们去净化。游戏的画风以像素为主。但在cg过程中则是一种写实的画风，画面非常细腻饱满，看着让人很舒服。 在游戏中，随着击杀的怪物数量增多，我们可以获得经验升级，每升1级就可以在三个物品中任选其一，它可能是一样武器，也可能是一个增益性的饰品。 每张地图中的一个小关卡分为三个阶段，3分钟一回合，第一阶段我们会攻击精英怪，而二三阶段分别对应首领boss的第一二阶段。游戏开始前会有一个引入剧情的小故事，每一阶段的boss击杀后也会有一段故事。最后阶段的故事便是你们所想的内容。 我们最多可以同时装备两个武器和六样增益性饰品。比较有意思的是饰品的名字和对应的文字介绍，这一点就留给大家自行探索。到了后期选择同类装备即可增强等级。武器最高是10级，而饰品等级上限各不相同。 地图内还会随机散布一些道具，需要我们去击破并拾取掉落物。游戏中还会随机刷新一个特殊的小怪，一个发光骷髅头击败他可以直接升1级。 游戏的局外养成也非常丰富。随着角色等级的提高，我们可以解锁基地内的不同设施。大致有技能树加点，需要消耗啤酒，而啤酒通过对局就可以获得；还有一个商店可以购买一个物品带入游戏，还可以额外解锁局内的可获得道具；同时我们还可以在基地内选择游玩无尽模式。挑战自我的极限 游戏中每一关的地图绘制都十分的精致，非常符合这个关卡的背景故事。例如破败的教堂，或是充满霓虹灯光色彩缤纷的城市。游戏内的小怪也很有设计感，每一个大地图的小怪样貌相同，而每一关的小怪会有一些许的变化。大致可以分为四类，以及它们对应的强化型。 总的来说这是一款十分不错的类吸血鬼幸存者游戏，并且游戏目前处于首发折扣当中，值得一玩。 [quote]欢迎关注鉴赏家: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/DCYXJLB] 大川游戏俱乐部 [/url] 欢迎加入Steam组:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45300930] 大川游戏俱乐部 [/url] 来一起感受游戏的乐趣喜欢这篇评论，也是可以顺手点个赞哟[/quote]

[h1] 《妖怪净化人》简评[/h1] [h2] 净化怪物 还是净化你？ [/h2] [h3] 净化怪物 净化身体( [/h3] 《妖怪净化人》不同于往常俯视平面视角而是2d视角的类幸存者游戏，游戏中我们将作为一名恶魔猎人使用各种各样的驱魔武器和道具来打败从四面八方涌来的敌人，而且游戏的boss来源也非常有趣，目前是来自中国以及美国的各三只首领。本作是制作组旗下游戏《灵魂恶魔猎人》的R18正式版，在此前的游戏基础上添加了r18元素，值得我们期待并展开游玩。 总体上作为一款肉鸽游戏来说是非常有趣而且加上了r18元素之后无疑更吸引人。 [h3] 核心玩法及亮点 [/h3] 游戏中的玩法就是比较大众化的类幸存者，一开始选择武器，武器一共三个种类：近战、远程、投掷。还有一些道具可选。需要我们注意的是，即时你选择了近战武器，但是有一个加快换弹速度的道具依然会刷出，所以要注意不要误选了。而且这些道具基本是也是各种影视作品以及文学作品中经常出现的除灵道具，例如大蒜、十字架等等。可以说是比较贴合题材的。 在当前的游戏正式版本中，添加了隐藏武器的选项。我们可以在基地的商店中购买来解锁。而在游戏中使用的方法也很简单，就是把对应的两把武器都拿到手并且在游戏过程中升满，那就会解锁隐藏武器，可以开始疯狂割草模式。 最有趣的是正式版添加了巢穴模式，这是一个超长时间的幸存者模式，每三分钟会刷新一个boss。听起来比较难，但是如果想玩到最刺激爽快的肉鸽割草体验还得是这个模式，超长时间以及超快boss刷新频率反倒是能让我们的构筑快速成型。 而且在这个版本中添加了r18元素，其中的体位xp涵盖较广而且全程高清步兵动态cg。还贴心的增加了游玩2小时可以直接解锁的功能，可以说非常不错了。虽然目前数量较少但质量是过硬的。 [h3] 短板与可优化部分 [/h3] 肉鸽方面的数值提升不太大，关卡模式其实打着比较坐牢。此外对手柄的适配一般。 [h3] 总结 [/h3] 《妖怪净化人》不同于往常俯视平面视角而是2d视角的类幸存者游戏，游戏中我们将作为一名恶魔猎人使用各种各样的驱魔武器和道具来打败从四面八方涌来的敌人。同时也是制作组旗下《灵魂恶魔猎人》的r18版本，cg高清无码质量奇高，实用性不错且xp覆盖广。总而言之本作是一款不错的肉鸽类幸存者游戏且带有数个高质量的r18cg。推荐喜欢肉鸽游戏的玩家可以入手。 [quote] 奏游戏之乐章，品人生之绚烂 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45672460/]欢迎加入 『 丰川集团 』[/url] [u][b]以丰川集团之名，行评测鉴赏之事[/b][/u][/quote] https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950350/_/

I went into this game expecting a rough, niche indie experience—and ended up surprisingly hooked. At its core, this is a run-and-gun, Vampire Survivors–inspired action game with a hack-and-slash twist. Movement is handled via keyboard, while attacks and dashes are aimed with the mouse, which sounds awkward on paper and honestly feels awkward at first. Jumping with an upward key while attacking and dashing in mouse directions creates a kind of messy, almost clumsy control scheme—but weirdly, that chaos becomes part of the fun. It’s frantic, noisy, and unapologetically scrappy, and the game leans into that energy rather than fighting it. Each run is structured into three short stages (roughly three minutes each), so a full attempt clocks in at around 8–10 minutes. Time flies as you kite enemies, dash through tight situations, and scour the map for drops and resources while waves escalate. Bosses appear at fixed intervals, and defeating them unlocks story scenes and progression. On paper, there are only a handful of bosses, which initially made me think this would be a quick one-hour clear—but in practice, the difficulty curve proved me very wrong. Early bosses are punishing, and later-stage patterns are brutal enough that I spent far longer learning them than expected. What really sells the gameplay loop is how progression is handled. At the beginning, the game feels borderline unfair. But as you unlock new weapons, characters, upgrades, hidden items, and shop recipes (even evolved weapons need to be purchased before they’re usable), the experience gradually opens up. It’s a textbook roguelite curve: struggle, unlock, adapt, retry—and eventually succeed. Even after finishing the main story, I found myself pushing the endless mode just to see how far I could survive. The audiovisual presentation does a lot of heavy lifting here. The soundtrack is energetic and retro-styled, leaning into upbeat 16-bit vibes rather than the overly dark, medieval tone a lot of similar games default to. That choice pays off—the music keeps the momentum high and makes repeated runs feel exciting instead of exhausting. Visually, the pixel art is sharp, and the Live2D scenes are polished and expressive, clearly made with care. Localization deserves special praise. The Korean translation isn’t just accurate—it’s crafted. The writing has personality, humor, and rhythm, to the point where it sometimes feels like the translator was having just as much fun as the original writer. Combined with full voice acting and expressive character animation, the narrative scenes land far better than you’d expect from a game of this scale. Content-wise, this is technically an adult game, but it honestly leans more toward “game” than “adult.” The number of unlockable scenes is relatively small compared to others in the genre, though their quality is high. Because the core gameplay is so solid, I can easily imagine this working as an all-ages release—and in fact, the developer has released a general-audience version, which says a lot about their confidence in the mechanics. If I had to nitpick, aiming awareness is critical. Since attacking, dashing, and surviving all depend on cursor position, losing track of it for even a moment can mean an instant death. It’s a skill you have to consciously develop. Overall, this game sits comfortably between a “solid” and a “great” indie title. It doesn’t reinvent the genre, but it executes its ideas with confidence, charm, and polish. For fans of retro action, roguelites, or fast-paced arcade-style combat, it’s an easy recommendation—and a lot more engaging than it first appears.

[後半に日本語レビューあり] [h1] A roguelike H-2D action game about “purifying” girl Anomalies [/h1] Myth-born “Anomalies” begin appearing in the real world, becoming a growing threat to humanity. The protagonist, an exorcist, travels across various regions to suppress their power and confront them in battle. This game is built around fast-paced, side-view 2D pixel action, featuring wave-based combat. While handling enemies swarming in from all directions, you face female bosses awaiting at the deepest part of each area. They are beautiful and alluring, yet at the same time extremely dangerous beings. Through the objective of “purification,” players experience temptation and tension simultaneously. Combat takes place from a side-view perspective but offers a strong sense of speed and responsiveness. There are also passive growth elements where you collect weapons and exorcism powers to build your setup. Gathering materials and currency during battles, purchasing recipes, and unlocking new weapons creates a flow that pairs extremely well with repeated runs. Visually, the action scenes stand out with carefully crafted pixel art. The Anomalies themselves feel oddly enchanting, while still maintaining a strong sense of danger as enemies, creating a unique atmosphere. Upon overcoming them, players are rewarded with “purification” scenes, where high-resolution, high-quality illustrations of impressive breasts can be fully enjoyed along with animation. This title achieves a well-balanced blend of replayability, gameplay, and presentation. It is especially well-suited for players who want to enjoy satisfying action in short sessions, particularly fans of VS-style action games. Even if you are not confident in your action skills, rest assured that all H scenes can be unlocked after around two hours of playtime. [h1] 女の子怪異を「浄化」するローグライクH-2Dアクション [/h1] 神話由来の「怪異（Anomalies ）」が現実世界に出現し、人類に脅威を与えはじめる。主人公の退魔師は、世界各地を巡って彼女たちの力を鎮めるために戦いへ身を投じていく。本作は、横視点の2Dピクセルアクションを核とした、テンポの速いウェーブ制バトルが特徴だ。四方から押し寄せる敵をさばきながら、各エリア最奥に待ち受ける女性ボスに挑む。彼女たちは美しく魅力的でありながら、同時に極めて危険な存在でもある。「浄化」という目的を通じて、プレイヤーは誘惑と緊張を同時に味わうことになる。 戦闘は横視点ではあるがスピード感ある操作性。また、武器や除霊パワーを集めてビルドを組み立てるパッシブ成長要素も存在する。戦闘中に素材や通貨を集め、レシピを購入して武器を解放していく流れは周回プレイとの相性が非常に良いと感じた。 ビジュアル面では、アクションシーンでは丁寧に描かれたピクセルアートが印象的。怪異たちの存在はどこか魅惑的で、しかし同時に「敵」としての緊張感も強く、そこに独特の雰囲気がある。そして打開時にはご褒美としての「浄化」があり、高解像度のすばら乳高品質絵をアニメーション込みで十分に堪能することができる。 リプレイ性・ゲーム性・演出面がバランスよく融合した作品であり、短時間で気持ちよくアクションを遊びたい人、とくにVS系アクションが好きな人には相性が良いと感じた。アクションが苦手でも、2時間のプレイ時間を重ねたらHシーン全開放が可能なので安心してほしい。 日本語テキスト有音声有藻無。 [quote][b]Check out our Steam curator ([url=store.steampowered.com/curator/36364102-Horny-Hentai-Festival/]link[/url]) , YouTube channel ([url=www.youtube.com/curatorhhf/]link[/url]), and X(Twitter) ([url=x.com/hhfcurator]link[/url])![/b][/quote]

《妖怪净化人》是一款2D像素横版类幸存者黄油，我们身为玩家需要扮演拥有丰富除魔经验的驱魔师詹姆斯，前往世界各地净化那些拥有超自然力量的怪物，守护世界和平。 游戏的战斗部分是横版射击+类幸存者的玩法，每3分钟刷新一只BOSS，单局10分钟左右，击败最终BOSS才能解锁HCG。局外养成很丰富，有天赋树、新角色、武器图纸养成等等玩法。据点最左侧的是挑战模式，挑战模式的经验更多，奖励也更多。我玩下来的主要感觉就是游戏前期有点太刮痧了，平衡也有点问题，但好在规则简单上手也挺快的。游戏的画风虽然说是是像素风但场景细节很多，美工也不错。瑟瑟部分全程日配，立绘也好看而且无需补丁。主要的建议就是降低游戏难度和局外养成肝度，或者说把武器和道具种类多加一些，伤害也提高些就更爽了。游戏的游玩时长达到两小时后即可一键解锁全回想，推荐喜欢幸存者类的玩家尝试一下，还是很不错的。 [quote][b]关注→[/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32969453/][b]✨大众点评鉴赏家✨[/b][/url] [b]新游速递 | 游戏评测 | 周免资讯[/b] [b]加入→[/b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/dzdp][b]🎮大众点评交流组🎮[/b][/url] [b]心得交流 | 试玩资格 | 聊天吹水[/b][/quote]

I will purify you is a side-scrolling action title developed and published by Cheese Burger Studio that blends fast-paced 2D combat, light RPG progression, and overtly mature themes into a niche but mechanically engaging experience. Presented in detailed pixel art, the game places players in the role of James, an exorcist affiliated with a Hunter Union tasked with eliminating supernatural “anomalies” that manifest in alluring yet dangerous forms. While its adult content clearly defines its audience, beneath that layer lies a surprisingly structured action system built around mobility, weapon variety, and boss-driven progression. At its core, the gameplay revolves around fluid side-scrolling combat. James moves through stages filled with hostile entities, combining melee strikes, ranged attacks, and special exorcism powers to clear waves of enemies. The combat system emphasizes responsiveness and rhythm, encouraging players to chain attacks together while carefully managing positioning and evasive maneuvers. Enemies are not mere cannon fodder; as stages progress, patterns become more complex and demand sharper reflexes. The pacing escalates steadily, rewarding players who adapt quickly to changing attack behaviors and environmental pressures. One of the game’s most compelling aspects is its build customization. Throughout missions, players gather resources used to unlock new weapons and abilities. The arsenal ranges from conventional blades and firearms to more imaginative, stylized equipment. Each weapon offers a distinct feel, influencing how encounters unfold. Some prioritize aggressive close-range engagement, while others support a safer, ranged approach. Complementing this is the Exorcism Power system, which introduces special abilities that can shift combat momentum when deployed strategically. This layered progression system gives players flexibility in shaping their playstyle rather than forcing a single optimal build. Boss encounters are designed as focal points of each region. These “anomalies” draw inspiration from mythological and supernatural themes, manifesting as powerful adversaries with unique attack patterns and escalating phases. Unlike standard enemies, bosses require careful observation and memorization of patterns. Victory demands patience and mastery of timing rather than brute force alone. These battles provide satisfying difficulty spikes and reinforce the game’s progression structure, making each victory feel earned rather than routine. Outside of combat, progression systems deepen engagement. A shop hub allows players to enhance stats, unlock new gear, and refine builds between missions. This RPG-like loop—fight, collect, upgrade, repeat—creates a sense of forward momentum. Although the narrative framework remains relatively straightforward, with James traveling across locations to purify supernatural threats, it serves effectively as connective tissue between action sequences. Visually, the pixel art presentation is polished and expressive. Character animations are fluid, and combat effects are vibrant without overwhelming clarity. Environments vary enough to maintain visual interest, though the primary emphasis remains on character design and encounter spectacle. Sound design supports the action competently, with impactful attack effects and atmospheric audio cues enhancing tension during boss fights. The game’s mature content is inseparable from its identity. It incorporates explicit themes and suggestive character portrayals that align with its “adult-only” categorization. These elements are integrated into both narrative context and post-battle sequences, clearly targeting a specific audience. For players comfortable with this thematic direction, it adds a distinctive flavor; for others, it may overshadow appreciation of the mechanical systems beneath. Reception within its niche audience has generally been positive. Many players highlight the satisfying combat flow, diverse weapon options, and engaging boss battles as standout features. Criticism tends to focus on limited stage variety and the relatively straightforward narrative. However, most feedback acknowledges that the title delivers on its intended design goals without pretending to be something broader in scope. Ultimately, I will purify you is a focused indie action game that combines responsive 2D combat, meaningful build customization, and myth-inspired boss encounters within a mature-themed framework. While its adult content narrows its appeal, the underlying gameplay systems offer enough depth and polish to satisfy players seeking a fast-paced side-scrolling challenge with RPG elements and stylized presentation. Rating: 8/10
